mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following was NOT an acharya associated with the Buddhist mahaviharas such as Nalanda and Vikramashila?
mcq_fix.why: Shilabhadra (Harsha's time) is not Pala-era, so 'Pala-era' made option 1 also correct

patterns: APPSC asks founder-of-university one-liners: Vikramashila = Dharmapala, Odantapuri = Gopala (APPSC key), Nalanda = Gupta (Kumaragupta I).
Atisha Dipankara Srijnana going to Tibet (11th c.) is a recurring APPSC item.
Other PSCs add: founder of Pala dynasty (Gopala), kings elected by people (Gopala, Nandivarman II), Balaputradeva's Nalanda grant, odd-one-out Taxila.
App MCQs go deeper (Ramacharita, Dhiman/Vitapala, mahavihara features, Senas) but are accurate; statement items more complex than PYQs.
